## Skill checklist (if adding/editing a skill)

- [ ] Lives at `skills/<kebab-case-name>/SKILL.md`
- [ ] Frontmatter has `name`, `description` (starts with "Use when…"), `license`
- [ ] Follows anatomy: Overview / When to Use / Process / Rationalizations / Red Flags / Verification
- [ ] Steps are concrete and numbered
- [ ] Verification checklist present
- [ ] Images optimized (< 600KB) in the skill's `assets/`
- [ ] Relative links resolve
